Even with the boost to the efficiency on the thermal-only cycles, the hybrid cycles still outperform them significantly. Taking the amount of ice that must be melted in the hybrid case, 55%, and dividing it by the amount of ice that must be melted in the thermal-only case, 80%, the data show that the hybrid cycle only requires 68.75% of the melting that the thermal case requires. That is a 31.25% reduction in energy. These data show that the team accomplished the milestone for Q12 & Q13 of achieving a 25% improvement over the baseline on a >1000cm2 prototype.
